import errno,json,os,resource,stat
def SbfSeal_fds(os_api):
 names=os_api.listdir('/proc/self/fd')
 if len(names)>4096: raise RuntimeError('FD inventory bound')
 result=[]
 for name in names:
  if not name.isascii() or not name.isdigit(): raise RuntimeError('FD inventory syntax')
  fd=int(name)
  try: os_api.fstat(fd)
  except OSError as e:
   if e.errno!=errno.EBADF: raise
  else: result.append(fd)
 return sorted(result)
assert os.getresuid()==(1000,)*3 and os.getresgid()==(1000,)*3
assert os.getgroups()==[]
assert resource.getrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_NOFILE)==(256,256)
assert resource.getrlimit(resource.RLIMIT_FSIZE)==(16384,16384)
assert SbfSeal_fds(os)==[0,1,2]
assert stat.S_ISCHR(os.fstat(0).st_mode)
assert (os.major(os.fstat(0).st_rdev),os.minor(os.fstat(0).st_rdev))==(1,3)
for fd in (1,2):
 t=os.fstat(fd)
 assert stat.S_ISREG(t.st_mode) and t.st_uid==0 and t.st_nlink==1
 assert stat.S_IMODE(t.st_mode)==0o600
with open('/proc/self/status',encoding='ascii') as f:
 s=dict(line.split(':',1) for line in f if ':' in line)
assert all(int(s[k],16)==0 for k in ('CapInh','CapPrm','CapEff','CapBnd','CapAmb'))
assert s['NoNewPrivs'].strip()=='1'
assert os.getpid()==1
assert os.stat('/proc/1/ns/pid').st_ino==os.stat('/proc/self/ns/pid').st_ino
assert os.stat('/').st_ino==os.stat('.').st_ino
with open('/proc/self/status',encoding='ascii') as f:
 q=dict(line.split(':',1) for line in f if ':' in line)
assert q['Threads'].strip()=='1'
with open('/proc/self/cgroup',encoding='ascii') as f:
 cg=f.read()
assert cg.startswith('0::/') and cg.count('\n')==1
assert os.statvfs('/').f_flag & os.ST_RDONLY
assert os.statvfs('/proc').f_flag & os.ST_RDONLY
assert not os.statvfs('/tmp').f_flag & os.ST_RDONLY
assert os.listdir('/dev')==[]
v=os.statvfs('/tmp')
assert v.f_blocks*v.f_frsize<=1048576 and v.f_files<=64
assert stat.S_IMODE(os.stat('/tmp').st_mode)==0o1777 and os.stat('/tmp').st_uid==0
with open('/proc/self/mountinfo',encoding='ascii') as f:
 rows=[line.split() for line in f]
assert {r[4] for r in rows}=={'/','/tmp','/proc'} and len(rows)==3
for r in rows:
 sep=r.index('-')
 assert not any(x.startswith(('shared:','master:','propagate_from:')) for x in r[6:sep])
 needed={'nosuid','nodev'} | ({'rw','noexec'} if r[4]=='/tmp' else {'ro'})
 if r[4]=='/proc': needed.add('noexec')
 assert needed<=set(r[5].split(','))
print(json.dumps({'SbfSeal':'tiny-public-v1','uid':1000,'gid':1000,'fds':[0,1,2]},sort_keys=True))
